_comment: Catalogue values that are legitimately identical to en.json. Entries may only be removed: tools/test/test-locale-catalogue-complete.cjs fails on any new identical value that is not listed here, and on a listed value that is no longer identical (translate it, then delete the entry). Keep the reason specific: a plain English sentence is never a legitimate entry.

reasons.keyboard-key-name: Keyboard key or shortcut name, printed as on the keycap in every layout.
reasons.brand-or-feature-name: Product, platform, protocol or feature name kept in its original form (Ergopti, Ollama, Spotlight, Hotstrings, Sticky…).
reasons.unit-or-abbreviation: Unit or technical abbreviation (s, km, RAM, CPM, WPM).
reasons.file-name-or-token: File name, URL or placeholder token that must not be translated.
reasons.symbol-or-placeholder-only: Glyphs, key sequences or placeholders without translatable words.
reasons.loanword-or-cognate: Word that is spelled the same in this locale (cognate or established loanword), checked per key.
